source_cause.layout: app/src/main/res/layout/fragment_place_search.xml sets place_search_results RecyclerView height to wrap_content inside fragment_main.xml auth_scroll ScrollView.
source_cause.listener: PlaceSearchFragment requests continuation only from RecyclerView.onScrolled when dy > 0 and !canScrollVertically(1).
source_cause.mechanism: The RecyclerView expands inside the parent ScrollView; user swipes scroll the outer ScrollView, so the RecyclerView callback does not observe page-end movement.
